title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.39
summary: Clearer next-series actions, simpler browsing options and more reliable episode-end handling.

sections.heading: Know which show you are choosing
bullets: The selected recommendation stays outlined and its title remains visible while using Browse show, Read synopsis or Save to My Stuff.

sections.heading: Keep browsing options focused
bullets: Customize rows is now in Settings → Skin & discovery → Rows. Existing arrangements and custom rows stay saved. Trakt recommendation rows keep their current source.

sections.heading: More reliable episode endings
bullets: Play Next keeps its end-of-file fallback when the online credits marker cannot be reached. Episode-end rating controls accept native integer episode identifiers.

sections.heading: Keep your complete setup
bullets: Update BlackLanturn preserves authorizations, playback settings, sources, saved titles, collections, searches, progress and unrelated add-ons. Both icon packs and existing compatibility fixes remain included.
